inst_deficit_routes_max_rel_diff.note: two methods on the M_H = 800 deficit E_i - F_A, about 1.3e-5 of F_A, so kernel round-off in F_A is amplified; measured 8.4e-5 to 9.0e-5 across BLAS kernels, the bound is about 11x that and still far below the 44x it supports

fv_vs_bvp_max_rel_diff.note: one graded n_x = 800 solve against collocation at tol 1e-10, set by its second-order discretisation; measured 5.99e-6 on three kernels

fv_vs_bvp_max_abs_diff_beta.note: beta(0), the same two solvers; measured 2.91e-6 on three kernels

ref_vs_bvp_max_rel_diff.note: the Richardson reference against collocation at tol 1e-10; measured 4.37e-8 on three kernels

ref_self_refinement_max_rel_diff.note: the reference against Richardson (800, 1600); measured 3.84e-8 on three kernels

first_integral_max_abs_resid.note: |q beta(0) - (1 + q - F_A)|/(1 + q) on the reference, never told to the discretisation; measured 6.4e-10 on three kernels

vkh_two_routes_max_rel_diff.note: the implicit relation solved for F_A and for gamma', Brent at xtol 1e-13, rtol 8.9e-16; measured 8.0e-15

vkh_pfo_limit_max_rel_error.note: evaluated at q = 1e10, so the finite-q error is about gamma/(2q), 1.5e-8 at gamma = 300

vkh_instantaneous_limit_rel_error.note: evaluated at gamma = 1e6, where the deficit q(1+q)^2/gamma^2 is 3.8e-10 of 1 + q = 20

fv_convergence_order.note: second-order finite volumes; 2.0000 between n_x = 400 and 800 at (gamma, q) = (10, 4)

f31_stored_vs_recomputed_rel.note: this page's recomputation of F3.1's definition against F3.1's committed vkh_max_error_pct, made on another machine; the residual is F3.1's uniform n_x = 400 discretisation, 1.29e-6 on three kernels, and F3.1's own number spreads 5e-12 relative across kernels
